n7a1433495c.headline: Milan slides as Trump rhetoric disappoints; Eni rallies while banks retreat
n7a1433495c.summary: Piazza Affari stayed negative late in the morning, chilled alongside other European bourses by Donald Trump's overnight speech. Eni rallied while banks retreated.
n7a1433495c.why: FTSE MIB is Italy's benchmark stock index, and Eni is a major Italian energy company whose shares often respond to oil prices.

impacts.name: Eni
impacts.why: Eni shares rallied while the broader market fell.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n7a1433495c.why_moved: Trump's overnight speech dampened hopes for a clear de-escalation roadmap, weighing on European bourses. Banks fell while the energy company Eni rose.

n6caa3e466f.headline: From April 1, Abkhazia fully relies on Enguri HPP electricity
n6caa3e466f.summary: Since April 1, the Georgian breakaway region of Abkhazia is being supplied with electricity entirely from the Enguri hydropower plant. The article compares this with last year's supply arrangements.
n6caa3e466f.why: The Enguri hydropower plant sits on the Georgia-Abkhazia border and is a major source of power for the region. Electricity supply arrangements shape energy costs and cross-border trade.

n9bbf0c973b.headline: Latest on Iran War
n9bbf0c973b.summary: President Donald Trump said US forces will keep hitting Iran 'very hard' in the coming period, according to an Associated Press report carried by News Talk WBAP.
n9bbf0c973b.why: The US-Iran conflict is a major geopolitical risk for oil supply and Gulf shipping, which affect energy prices and inflation expectations worldwide.

source.name: News Talk WBAP 820 AM and 93.3 FM

sources.name: News Talk WBAP 820 AM and 93.3 FM

n9bbf0c973b.why_moved: Continued military strikes raise the risk of further disruption to Middle East energy supply, which tends to lift oil prices and risk premia.

n084a0cf292.headline: Bulgaria records 569.1 million euro Budget deficit in January-February 2026
n084a0cf292.summary: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry recorded a consolidated budget deficit of 569.1 million euro in the first two months of 2026, below the 0.6 billion euro projected earlier.
n084a0cf292.why: Budget balances shape government borrowing needs and sovereign credit assessments, which influence Bulgarian bond yields and euro-area risk perception.

ncd1a25d35f.headline: Irans Tollbooth Tightens Grip On Hormuz As Ships
ncd1a25d35f.summary: Iran's tollbooth tightens its grip on the Strait of Hormuz as ships transit the waterway. The crisis affects global oil flows and tanker operations.
ncd1a25d35f.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so disruptions there quickly affect crude supply and prices.
ncd1a25d35f.why_moved: Iran is tightening control of transit through the Strait of Hormuz, which the report links to disruption of global oil flows and tanker operations.

nb69961bf61.headline: Mozambique Pays Debt to IMF in Full
nb69961bf61.summary: Mozambique fully paid its outstanding debt of 515.04 million Special Drawing Rights, equivalent to $630.1 million, to the IMF last March. The payment settles its obligations to the fund.
nb69961bf61.why: The IMF is a key lender to developing economies, and repayment status affects a country's credit standing and access to finance.

n94019f9b5e.headline: Trump's mercurial, constantly changing import taxes took American businesses on a wild ride
n94019f9b5e.summary: Reason Magazine reports that the president's emergency import tariffs changed frequently and fluctuated with his mood, creating a volatile environment for US businesses.
n94019f9b5e.why: Tariff policy changes affect import costs, supply chains and trade-exposed company earnings across US markets.

n0418a076ec.headline: Kenya: Ruto Appoints Council to Oversee National Infrastructure Fund
n0418a076ec.summary: President William Ruto appointed a Governing Council to oversee the newly established National Infrastructure Fund, with Treasury Cabinet Secretary John Mbadi as chair. The fund is meant to drive investment-led infrastructure financing.
n0418a076ec.why: Infrastructure funds channel public and private capital into roads, energy and transport, shaping project pipelines for contractors and lenders.

n903302fc3b.headline: Lib Dems call for 10p fuel duty cut to help motorists with Iran living costs
n903302fc3b.summary: Liberal Democrat leader Sir Ed Davey called for a 10p fuel duty cut and a 10 cut in rail fares to help motorists and travellers with cost-of-living pressures linked to Iran.
n903302fc3b.why: Fuel duty is a tax on petrol and diesel, so changes to it affect UK consumer costs and government tax revenue.

nf086fc20b7.headline: Stellantis could make Chinese EVs at idled Brampton plant
nf086fc20b7.summary: Stellantis is in talks to bring its Chinese EV partner Leapmotor's vehicles to Canada through its idling Brampton plant. The talks concern production at an currently idle facility.
nf086fc20b7.why: Stellantis is a global automaker formed from Fiat Chrysler and PSA, and Leapmotor is its Chinese EV partner.

impacts.name: Stellantis
impacts.why: Using an idle Canadian plant for Chinese-built EVs would change Stellantis's North American production footprint.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

ne76fc54de2.headline: Foreign investors target core assets in Vietnam’s evolving M&A landscape
ne76fc54de2.summary: Vietnam’s mergers and acquisitions landscape is entering a more sophisticated phase, with foreign investors increasingly targeting core business segments.
ne76fc54de2.why: M&A activity shows where capital is flowing and how foreign investors are positioning in emerging Asian markets.

n655b5bcca3.headline: Servos under the pump over prices as cost cuts kick in
n655b5bcca3.summary: Servo operators are under pressure over prices as cost cuts kick in, with the opposition criticising the prime minister's televised speech on the fuel crisis.
n655b5bcca3.why: Petrol retail margins and pump prices depend on wholesale fuel costs, which are shaped by global crude and refined product supply.

nae0a066908.headline: No clear case for longer Iran war with goals won: PM
nae0a066908.summary: Australia will join a snap meeting to end disruption to shipping in a critical oil corridor. The prime minister said there is no clear case for a longer Iran war with goals won.
nae0a066908.why: Disruption to oil shipping lanes affects fuel costs and supply for importing economies such as Australia.

n73dbf3ef58.headline: Trump's VA killed a home loan program. Vets are now losing their homes because of it
n73dbf3ef58.summary: Foreclosures on VA-backed home loans are at their highest level in a decade, and the VA's fix is months away and could still leave veterans worse off than other homeowners.
n73dbf3ef58.why: VA loans are government-guaranteed mortgages for US veterans, and their performance affects housing finance and mortgage-market risk.

n1229e7c56a.headline: Why Archer Aviation Stock Plummeted 27.4% Last Month
n1229e7c56a.summary: Archer Aviation's stock dropped 27.4% last month after a valuation pullback in response to several bearish catalysts.
n1229e7c56a.why: Archer is an electric air-taxi developer whose share price is sensitive to funding needs, regulatory timelines and sentiment toward emerging aviation technology.

n7cd092c566.headline: ASX vows reform after placing 'investors over markets'
n7cd092c566.summary: A final report on exchange operator ASX has noted a defensive culture and a focus on shareholder returns over market needs. ASX has vowed reform in response.
n7cd092c566.why: ASX Limited operates Australia's main securities exchange and clearing systems. Governance and regulatory scrutiny of the operator affect confidence in Australian market infrastructure.

nf7c0b48e57.headline: UAE crude shipments head to South Korea under bilateral energy deal
nf7c0b48e57.summary: South Korea said emergency crude oil shipments from the United Arab Emirates are on their way under a bilateral energy agreement.
nf7c0b48e57.why: South Korea imports nearly all of its crude oil, so supply deals with Gulf producers directly affect its energy security and refining costs.

n29338e01f8.headline: Iran fires on Middle East neighbors as Trump claims threat from Tehran nearly eliminated
n29338e01f8.summary: Iran has fired more missiles at Israel and Gulf Arab states, demonstrating Tehran's continued ability to attack, even as Trump claimed the threat was nearly eliminated.
n29338e01f8.why: Attacks on Gulf states threaten energy infrastructure and shipping in one of the world's most important oil-producing regions.
n29338e01f8.why_moved: Continued Iranian missile fire at Israel and Gulf Arab states raises risk to regional energy supply and shipping.

naa288e74cc.headline: Bank margins to narrow on tighter liquidity
naa288e74cc.summary: Fitch Ratings expects Vietnam's banking system liquidity to stay tight in the near term due to economic risks and keen competition. This will pressure lending margins and profitability.
naa288e74cc.why: Fitch is a global credit rating agency whose sector reports help investors assess bank profitability and credit risk. Lending margins drive bank earnings.

n08a5b489e0.headline: IIFCL to raise up to $1 billion through MIGA guarantee fund this quarter to foster infra sector: MD
n08a5b489e0.summary: India Infrastructure Finance Company plans to raise up to $1 billion through an MIGA guarantee fund in the current quarter. IIFCL is in advanced talks with global banks for the long-term debt.
n08a5b489e0.why: IIFCL is an Indian government-backed lender that funds infrastructure projects. Its borrowing plans affect the availability of long-term project finance in India.

nf01c68d6d9.headline: As digital asset treasuries face ‘acute stress,’ this Bitcoin firm continues to buy
nf01c68d6d9.summary: Digital asset treasury companies face acute stress, according to reports. Bitcoin treasury Nakamoto this week announced it sold some of its crypto, while some other firms continue buying despite lower share prices.
nf01c68d6d9.why: Digital asset treasury companies hold large amounts of bitcoin on their balance sheets, so their share prices and holdings can move with the crypto market.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Bitcoin treasury firms selling holdings adds to supply pressure while others keep buying.

nd8ac7e8519.headline: John Swinney says Westminster should be recalled amid energy crisis
nd8ac7e8519.summary: John Swinney will say that Westminster must be recalled to force the UK Labour government to provide real support for households and businesses in an energy crisis.
nd8ac7e8519.why: Energy bills and business energy costs in the UK are shaped by national policy, so calls for emergency support affect household spending and corporate margins.

ncb8ddffeef.headline: Stocks slide, dollar advances after Trump speech on Iran war
ncb8ddffeef.summary: The greenback rose against most currencies after a speech by President Donald Trump on the Iran war, while stocks slid. The report gives no further detail on the market moves.
ncb8ddffeef.why: The US dollar is the main global reserve currency, so its moves affect dollar-denominated assets, commodities and emerging-market funding. Broad stock indexes such as the S&P 500 track large US listed companies.
ncb8ddffeef.why_moved: The report says the dollar rose against most currencies and stocks slid after the speech on the Iran war. Geopolitical escalation typically pushes investors toward the dollar and away from risk assets.

n304c0c801d.headline: Nvidia chips probe in S’pore: CFO of local tech firm becomes fourth executive to be charged
n304c0c801d.summary: Jenny Lim of Aperia Cloud Services was charged with fraud in the Singapore District Court on April 2. She is the fourth executive charged in the probe into Nvidia chips.
n304c0c801d.why: Nvidia is the leading supplier of AI accelerator chips, and export controls on these chips are a major policy issue. Enforcement cases like this shape compliance risk for chip supply chains.

n40993e3f1b.headline: Govt Assures IMF That Oil Price Increases Will Be Transferred to Consumers
n40993e3f1b.summary: Pakistan has assured the International Monetary Fund that it will pass on changes in global oil prices to consumers. It also plans targeted subsidies.
n40993e3f1b.why: The IMF oversees Pakistan's loan programme and sets conditions on fiscal and energy policy. Fuel pricing decisions affect inflation and the country's fiscal position.

n454591b478.headline: China Urges Pakistan to Clear $220 Million in Dues to Chinese Energy Firm
n454591b478.summary: China has urged Pakistan to settle about $220 million in overdue payments owed to United Energy Pakistan, signaling mounting pressure on Islamabad over the debt.
n454591b478.why: Overdue payments to Chinese energy investors reflect Pakistan's fiscal strain and affect China-Pakistan economic ties, including infrastructure projects. Such arrears weigh on the country's sovereign credit profile.

n87e8cf3db6.headline: Tesla sales rise after brutal year of Musk boycotts but still fall short of expectations
n87e8cf3db6.summary: Tesla vehicle sales rose over the last three months after a difficult year of boycotts tied to Elon Musk's politics. Sales still fell short of expectations.
n87e8cf3db6.why: Tesla is the largest pure-play electric vehicle maker, and its delivery trends are a key indicator for the EV sector. Brand controversy has been a factor in its recent sales.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Sales recovered from prior lows but remained below forecasts, a mixed signal for demand.
